set memory xram 0x01b4 92

0x01b4                      5c 00 \.
mory xram 0x0549 0

set memory xram 0x054c 0
set m0x0549                      00 00 ..
0x054a                      00 00 ..
0x054b                      02 00 ..
0x054c                      00 00 ..
emory xram 0x054d 0
set memory xram 0x054e 5
run 0 0x56a
echo FINAL_MEMORY
dx 0 0x7ff
quit
